entries.name: Bandages
entries.description: A pack of bandages usually found in first aid kits.  Adds  8 charges  to the Med-kit.

entries.name: Butterfly Tape
entries.description: Medical quality tape used to close small wounds.   Increases  healing speed by  5% .

entries.name: Refined Serum
entries.description: A refined version of the putrid serum that’s mostly safe for human consumption. Mostly.  Press the  Secondary Action button  while healing with the Med-kit to use the Refined Serum.Grants the Survivor  5% Haste  and  increases  their field

entries.name: Rubber Gloves
entries.description: Disposable medical gloves to avoid cross-contamination.   Increases  the Bonus skill check size by  10% .

entries.name: Medical Scissors
entries.description: Scissors designed to easily cut through textiles.   Increases  healing speed by  10% .

entries.name: Needle & Thread
entries.description: Not exactly a medical device, however it can be used to quickly and painfully close up a wound.   Increases  the chances of triggering a Skill Check by  10% . Increases  progression bonus for succeeding Great Skill Checks by  5% .

entries.name: Self Adherent Wrap
entries.description: A pack of bandages that sticks to themselves without the need of clips for a faster patch-up that requires less readjustments.  Adds  8 charges  to the Med-kit. Increases  healing speed by  5% .

entries.name: Sponge
entries.description: A mundane sponge used to soak up extra blood, providing easier access to wounds.   Increases  the Bonus skill check size by  20% .

entries.name: Gauze Roll
entries.description: A sterile gauze used for a variety of wounds. Part of a total wound care system.  Adds  10 charges  to the Med-kit.

entries.name: Surgical Suture
entries.description: A medical device used to close and hold body tissue. Even though it's very effective, the surgical suture is challenging to use.   Increases  the chances of triggering a Skill Check by  15% . Increases  progression bonus for succeeding Grea

entries.name: Abdominal Dressing
entries.description: A highly absorbent pad that prevents bodily fluid leakage when applied to large abdominal wounds.   Increases  healing speed by  15% .

entries.name: Styptic Agent
entries.description: A white powder with coagulant properties. Apply the agent to a wound to stop it from hemorrhaging.  Increases the efficiency when healing yourself with a Medkit by  15% .

entries.name: Anti-Exhaustion Syringe
entries.description: A mysterious fluid that reinvigorates both body and mind.  Press the  Secondary Action  button while healing with the Med-kit to use the Anti-Exhaustion Syringe.The affected Survivor loses the  Exhausted  Status Effect upon use.Consumes the

entries.name: Gel Dressings
entries.description: A pack of gel forming pads used to patch up heavily exudating wounds.  Adds  16 charges  to the Med-kit.

entries.name: Clean Rag
entries.description: A mundane rag. Suspiciously clean.   Increases  the Toolbox's repair speed by  20% .

entries.name: Instructions
entries.description: Someone quickly painted what seems to be repair instructions on this piece of bark.  Eliminates Skill Checks while repairing with the Toolbox.

entries.name: Scraps
entries.description: Springs, screws and gears. Mostly unusable junk.  Adds  8 charges  to the Toolbox.

entries.name: Cutting Wire
entries.description: A rudimentary cutting tool made from a jagged metal wire and two wooden handles.   Increases  the Toolbox's sabotage speed by  20% .

entries.name: Protective Gloves
entries.description: Thick gloves which reduce manual dexterity but protect hands from injury.  Prevents the Killer from being notified when sabotaging a hook with the Toolbox.

entries.name: Socket Swivels
entries.description: Swivels provide bend and flexibility for bolts that are out of reach, deep within mechanical devices.   Increases  the Toolbox repair speed by  30% .

entries.name: Spring Clamp
entries.description: Useful tool to clamp hoses or hold wires in place and prevent damage or injury.  The distance at which your repairs can be heard is reduced by  8 meters .

entries.name: Wire Spool
entries.description: A portable but heavy spool of copper wire.  Adds  12 charges  to the Toolbox.

entries.name: Grip Wrench
entries.description: An adjustable wrench with a tough grip. Essential in any Toolbox.  Hooks sabotaged using the Toolbox take an extra  20 seconds  to respawn.

entries.name: Hacksaw
entries.description: A small hand saw mounted with a metal cutting blade.   Increases  the Toolbox's sabotage speed by  30% .

entries.name: Brand New Part
entries.description: This intricate mechanical part feels oddly out of place. It is clean and shiny as if straight out of the factory.   Toolbox Repair  action is replaced with  Install Brand New Part .During the installation, you will be faced with a difficult

entries.name: Battery
entries.description: A standard battery of unknown brand.  Adds  2 seconds  of use to the Flashlight.

entries.name: Broken Bulb
entries.description: A damaged bulb that causes a spooky flickering effect.  Causes the Flashlight to flicker. Increases  the brightness of the Flashlight beam by  15% . Increases  Blindness duration by  30% . Increases  the spookiness just a little.

entries.name: Leather Grip
entries.description: A leather strip wrapped around the Flashlight for more grip.   Increases  the accuracy of the Flashlight beam by  20% .

entries.name: Power Bulb
entries.description: A tiny Flashlight bulb that packs more wattage for a brighter, more powerful light beam.   Increases  the brightness of the Flashlight beam by  20% . Increases  Blindness duration by  10% .

entries.name: Wide Lens
entries.description: A thin wide lens in perfect condition. Designed to spread the Flashlight beam at the cost of reducing its range of effectiveness.   Decreases  the range of the Flashlight beam by  25% . Increases  the width of the Flashlight beam by  25% .

entries.name: Focus Lens
entries.description: A thick glass lens that focuses the Flashlight beam to increase its intensity.   Increases  the range of the Flashlight beam by  25% . Decreases  the width of the Flashlight beam by  15% . Increases  the brightness of the Flashlight beam by

entries.name: Heavy Duty Battery
entries.description: A battery marked as "industrial strength."  Adds  4 seconds  of use to the Flashlight.

entries.name: Low Amp Filament
entries.description: A filament bulb designed to extend a Flashlight battery's life.   Decreases  Flashlight battery consumption by  24% .

entries.name: Rubber Grip
entries.description: A rubber grip specifically fitting Flashlights for more grip.   Increases  the accuracy of the Flashlight beam by  40% .

entries.name: TIR Optic
entries.description: A lens and reflector combo which can magnify a Flashlight's beam.   Increases  the brightness of the Flashlight beam by  30% . Increases  Blindness duration by  15% .

entries.name: Intense Halogen
entries.description: A chemical bulb that generates an intensely clear light.   Increases  the brightness of the Flashlight beam by  40% . Increases  Blindness duration by  20% .

entries.name: Long Life Battery
entries.description: A recent model of battery that lasts longer.  Adds  6 seconds  of use to the Flashlight.

entries.name: High-end Sapphire lens
entries.description: A wide lens made of unscratchable sapphire that optimises the power and range of the light beam.   Increases  the range of the Flashlight beam by  25% . Increases  the width of the Flashlight beam by  25% . Increases  the brightness of the

entries.name: Odd Bulb
entries.description: A heavy and completely opaque bulb of unknown origin which emits a faint light even when turned off.   Increases  the brightness of the Flashlight beam by  50% . Increases  Blindness duration by  25% . Increases  Flashlight battery consumpt

entries.name: Glowing Ink
entries.description: Some of the images seemed to jump right off the page.   Increases  the duration of auras revealed by maps for  2 seconds .

entries.name: Gnarled Compass
entries.description: It seems to set itself to the perfect distance every time.   Increases  a map's charges by  2 .

entries.name: Retardant Jelly
entries.description: A slimy, translucent substance with a ghastly lavender shade. This jelly from unknown origin is highly resistant to heat.   Slows down  the burning rate of the Map by  20% .

entries.name: Unusual Stamp
entries.description: A wooden stamp with a crosshatched rubber pad used to mark documents. It is unclear as to how or by whom this stamp was originally used. Can be used with a Map.   Increases  the range of the Map tracking ability by  8 meters .

entries.name: Yellow Wire
entries.description: A small electrical wire. Both ends are heavily damaged like it has been forcefully torn out of its intended location. Can be tied around a Map to enhance its aura reading ability.  Unlocks the ability to  track exit gates .

entries.name: Battered Tape
entries.description: Additional pieces of parchment hung loosely from the map, hastily affixed with tape.   Increases  the maximum range of a map by  8 meters .

entries.name: Odd Stamp
entries.description: A stamp carved out of sturdy blonde wood. The text found at the base is incomprehensible: "kw'zvre'od". Can be used with a Map.   Increases  the range of the Map tracking ability by  12 meters .

entries.name: Sharpened Flint
entries.description: When sparked near the map, new sigils appeared in unexpected locations.  When using the map, all totems within range are  revealed .

entries.name: Crimson Stamp
entries.description: Only those with absolute confidence dared to place their seal upon the map.  The Killer's Aura is revealed within  8 meters  of the beam of light.Reduces beam of light duration by  10 seconds .Reduces number of charges by  2 .

entries.name: Friendship Charm
entries.description: Someone's thumb has worn off the initials once carved into it.   Increases  a key's charges by  1 .

entries.name: Prayer Beads
entries.description: A chain of matte beads of various sizes used in praying rituals. Can be attached to the Key.  Adds  15 seconds  of use to the Key.

entries.name: Shrill Whistle
entries.description: The high-pitched scream gives a sense of urgency to everything.   Decreases  the time to channel a key by  35% .

entries.name: Braided Bauble
entries.description: Four thin but sturdy cords, all masterfully wrapped around one another.   Increases  the duration of auras revealed by keys by  2 seconds .

entries.name: Gold Token
entries.description: A gold token with a dull appearance. Both faces are smooth and void of any inscriptions. Can be attached to the Key using its jump ring to channel the key's aura reading ability.  Reveals  Survivor auras  when within a  48 meter  range.

entries.name: Milky Glass
entries.description: This opaque piece of glass emits a dull vibrating noise. When the Key is used to unlock the Hatch, the glass token protects the Key from breaking, channeling The Fog's energy into the glass.  Do not lose the Key when unlocking the Hatch, lo

entries.name: Unique Wedding Ring
entries.description: An engraved wedding ring that emerged from The Fog and resonates with an indescribable and incomprehensible energy. The Obsession and yourself both see each other's aura at all times. Decreases  your chances to be The Killer’s Obsession.

entries.name: Weaved Ring
entries.description: A mundane key ring in appearance with an unusual bluish dark sheen. The ring binds the Key to the user, preventing its loss even in the darkest of times.  Do not lose the Key on death, lose this add-on instead.

entries.name: Blood Amber
entries.description: A blood-red amber striped with black veins. The amber is warm to the touch.Using this key reveals the Killer to you, and you to the Killer.Reduces aura reveal time by  6 seconds .Reduces  number of charges  by  2 .

entries.name: Volcanic Stone
entries.description: The heat of its birthplace glows within this living rock.   Decreases  the Fog Vial cooldown by  5 seconds .

entries.name: Reactive Compound
entries.description: Pressure builds within the vial. Its contents beg for release.   Decreases  the Fog Cloud's expansion time by  1 second .

entries.name: Oily Sap
entries.description: The emerging fog clings to the air, overwhelming the senses for even longer.   Increases  Fog Cloud duration by  2 seconds .

entries.name: Mushroom Formula
entries.description: Blooming wisps of fog grasp at the environment, reaching farther and farther out.   Increases  maximum Fog Cloud size by  2 meters .

entries.name: Potent Extract
entries.description: One drop is enough to change the consistency of this strange elixir.   Increases  the Fog Cloud's opacity by  100% . Decreases  the Fog Cloud's duration by  50% . Decreases  the Fog Cloud's size by  25% .
